title: DojoLiq Triple Mango 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Immerse yourself in exotic sweetness with Vaporesso DojoLiq Triple Mango. This richly formulated blend focuses entirely on the lush, creamy nectar of ripe Mango, layering different facets of the fruit to create a deeply vivid profile. It delivers a heavy, syrupy sweetness on the inhale and a smooth, tropical finish on the exhale, making it a must-try for fruit enthusiasts. Formulated with a bespoke 45% VG / 55% PG ratio tailored specifically to this flavour, this Nicotine Salt e-liquid is crafted to provide exceptional clarity and a smooth throat hit. This fine-tuned blend performs flawlessly with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) refillable pod kits and starter devices, ensuring sharp flavour transmission. Brought to you by the hardware specialists at Vaporesso, the DojoLiq collection captures the vibrant, authentic flavours of their popular Dojo series in a versatile 10ml format. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, these e-liquids offer rapid nicotine satisfaction and consistently bold taste from the first drop to the last.
